provenance.author: Capabilio
provenance.note: Projects are original briefs written for Capabilio. Certifications are real programmes from their providers; only name, provider and link are recorded, and links are checked on import.

projects.title: Sales dashboard from a messy CSV
projects.description: Take a deliberately messy sales CSV, clean it (missing values, duplicates, inconsistent labels), define 3 KPIs, and build a one-page dashboard that a manager could act on.
evidence: A short log of every cleaning decision
One page of insights and recommendations

projects.title: SQL analysis of a public dataset
projects.description: Pick a public relational dataset, write at least 10 queries using joins, grouping and CTEs to answer real questions, and present what you found.
evidence: A short write-up of the questions and answers

projects.title: A/B test analysis and recommendation
projects.description: Analyse an A/B test dataset: check the setup, test the difference, report uncertainty honestly, and write a decision memo for a non-technical reader.

projects.title: Customer cohort and funnel analysis
projects.description: From an events table, build a signup-to-purchase funnel and monthly retention cohorts using window functions or pandas, and explain where users drop off.

projects.title: Predict house prices end to end
projects.description: Build a regression model on a public housing dataset: explore, engineer features, validate with cross-validation, and report error in plain terms.
evidence: A short note on what the model gets wrong

projects.title: A classifier with honest evaluation
projects.description: Train a classifier on an imbalanced dataset, show why accuracy misleads, choose better metrics, and demonstrate how you checked for overfitting.

projects.title: Neural network from scratch in NumPy
projects.description: Implement a small neural network with forward pass, backpropagation and gradient descent using only NumPy, and train it on a simple dataset.
evidence: Training curve and a short explanation

projects.title: Serve a model behind an API
projects.description: Wrap a trained model in a small web API with input validation and a test, containerise or document how to run it, and keep the code in version control.

projects.title: Bias check of a model
projects.description: Evaluate a model's errors across groups in a dataset, document any gaps, and propose one mitigation with before-and-after numbers.

projects.title: Command-line tool with tests and CI
projects.description: Build a small command-line tool, cover it with unit tests, and set up an automated test run on every push.

projects.title: Library system database and queries
projects.description: Design a normalised database for a library, load sample data, write the queries a librarian would need, and add an index you can justify.
evidence: A short note on the index and its effect
